evidence: Carries the Wallet maintainer label and directly protects wallet encryption passphrase keys derived in CCrypter.
rationale: Prevents lingering wallet encryption key and IV material from remaining in un-cleansed memory after key derivation. While it improves memory hygiene for CCrypter::BytesToKeySHA512AES and BIP32 seeds, it addresses defense-in-depth rather than an active exploit or fund-loss bug.
